info.description: Updates a timeline event. You can update events of type Custom Event.
info.title: AWS Systems Manager Incident Manager

requests.description: A replication set replicates and encrypts your data to the provided Regions with the provided KMS key.
requests.name: POST /createReplicationSet
requests.note: Replace {{AWS_SYSTEMS_MANAGER_INCIDENT_MANAGER_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Creates a response plan that automates the initial response to incidents. A response plan engages contacts, starts chat channel collaboration, and initiates runbooks at the beginning of an incident.
requests.name: POST /createResponsePlan
requests.note: Replace {{AWS_SYSTEMS_MANAGER_INCIDENT_MANAGER_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Creates a custom timeline event on the incident details page of an incident record. Incident Manager automatically creates timeline events that mark key moments during an incident. You can create custom timeline events to mark important events that Incident Manager can detect automatically.
requests.name: POST /createTimelineEvent
requests.note: Replace {{AWS_SYSTEMS_MANAGER_INCIDENT_MANAGER_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Delete an incident record from Incident Manager.
requests.name: POST /deleteIncidentRecord
requests.note: Replace {{AWS_SYSTEMS_MANAGER_INCIDENT_MANAGER_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Deletes all Regions in your replication set. Deleting the replication set deletes all Incident Manager data.
requests.name: POST /deleteReplicationSet#arn
requests.note: Replace {{AWS_SYSTEMS_MANAGER_INCIDENT_MANAGER_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Deletes the resource policy that Resource Access Manager uses to share your Incident Manager resource.
requests.name: POST /deleteResourcePolicy
requests.note: Replace {{AWS_SYSTEMS_MANAGER_INCIDENT_MANAGER_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Deletes the specified response plan. Deleting a response plan stops all linked CloudWatch alarms and EventBridge events from creating an incident with this response plan.

requests.description: Deletes a timeline event from an incident.
